name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova input-group, fixed: the group looks disabled only when its input or textarea is, not when a button in an addon is; a contenteditable control, :focus-visible whenever it has focus, darkens the border a step instead of the dark border and 3px ring; a popup opened from inside the group, as a menu of a composer's toolbar, sits 8px clear of the whole group rather than of its trigger (inputGroupPopupOffset, Base UI's sideOffset for it), so it never covers the text; where the group folds its trigger away, it opens from the group's button marked data-input-group-fold (inputGroupPopupAnchor, Base UI's anchor for it). InputGroup size="lg": a sign-in screen's, 44px, its text 16px and its icons 20px. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md).
